* fix: address Codex review findings on 5.0.0; release v5.0.1

- A clean end of the event stream (2.x never reconnects /api/event) is
  treated as a dropped stream and reconciled, on both the main pump and
  the session.wait-settled path, instead of finishing a truncated turn.
- Dropped-stream recovery succeeds only on proof the turn concluded (the
  last stored message finished or failed, or an approval is pending).
- Mixed approval continuations: the resumed execution's ending is held
  until this prompt's own execution starts or it is delivered; a held
  failure is surfaced if the session settles first; recovery credits only
  answers stored after this prompt's own user message.
- wrapError classifies a wrapped typed cause, keeping preflight transient
  and auth failures retryable / LoadAPIKeyError.
- The caller abort listener is detached when the turn ends.

* fix: await a predecessor only when an approval resumes the prompt's session

Mixed continuations route each approval reply to its own session, which
can differ from the prompt's (createNewSession / providerOptions.sessionId).
The predecessor-ending hold now applies only when a replied approval
targets the prompt's session; otherwise the prompt's own terminal ends the
call. Addresses Codex review on #45.

* fix: share approval-session routing with predecessor detection

The mixed-continuation predecessor check fell back to the turn's session
while reply dispatch falls back to the pinned session first, so an
untracked approval on a pinned session with new content on another
session wrongly held that session's terminal. Both now use one resolver
(approvalSessionFor). Found in adversarial review (R5).

* fix: clear the predecessor hold when its ending precedes this prompt's enqueue

An approval-resumed execution ending before the queued prompt's
inbox.enqueued was dropped as stale without clearing
awaitingPredecessorEnd, so this turn's own ending could later be skipped.
An ending that arrives before the prompt was accepted is necessarily the
predecessor's.
